listPresence.reason: SW62 keeps workspaceData in the flag-off branch and uses the existing issue-record visibility path plus an owned literal document-header permission read when bounded metadata is enabled. The 520-case warm/reloaded HTTP differential compares status, headers, response order and values, and stored roster across the principal/API-key matrix for roster/route/document/issue filters, malformed document-filter queries, current and previous slugs, full/minimal updates and removals, and invalid clients. Only generated lastSeenAt values are normalized; distinct fixture timestamps preserve the literal hub order. Canceled bounded document reads return 503 instead of a permission denial. Source ownership is zero after every operation, with no full metadata decode; shared bool-only event/agent consumers remain outside this review.

presenceDocumentPermission.reason: SW62 retains the original bool helper in flag-off mode. Bounded mode reads the existing policy first, then independently owns the current installed first ID-or-current-slug document header through literal documentRole and closes it before returning. Normal forbidden access and malformed query policy results remain false; cancellation and bounded read failures propagate to the presence handler's 503 response. The warm/reloaded HTTP differential covers explicit user/workspace grants, inherited/private/missing teams, missing documents and previous slugs across all existing principal/API-key combinations, with exact responses and zero leaked work. Tier A SW64 separately proves native header parity, first-match collisions, generation/default-key behavior, admission and release normally, persistently and under race.
